changelog:
Feature: configurable output image format (PNG, WebP or JPEG) instead of always PNG
- Feature: optional second encode engine ("Skia + ImageSharp") exposing WebP encoding method (0-6) and near-lossless pre-processing not available via Skia alone
- Feature: configurable image quality (1-100) for lossy encoding (WebP lossy / JPEG)
- Feature: configurable lossless compression effort (0-100) for PNG and WebP lossless
- Feature: configurable JPEG chroma subsampling (4:2:0 / 4:2:2 / 4:4:4)
- Feature: configurable maximum thumbnail resolution (longest side cap) with presets and a custom value, independent of render DPI
- Config page now shows only the options relevant to the selected format/engine, and displays the bundled ImageSharp version
- JPEG output automatically disables transparent padding since JPEG has no alpha channel
description: Automatically generates cover thumbnails for PDF files in your Jellyfin library by rendering the first page of each PDF. Supports configurable render resolution (DPI) and thumbnail padding mode.
name: PDF Thumbnails
overview: Generates thumbnail images from the first page of PDF files.
